name: local_courseplanner_builder
description: Walkthrough for the Course calendar builder page (local_courseplanner).

steps.title: The semester builder
steps.content: This is where you build the week-by-week grid students will see. You can manage related tools, add optional intro text, arrange topics, and edit individual cells from one page.

steps.title: Quick links
steps.content: Jump to related tools from here: Manage Content for blueprint topics, Manage Dates for semester dates and holidays, Open Semester Preview for the student view, and Coverage Check to compare what is placed vs missing.

steps.title: Auto-fill helpers
steps.content:
The green buttons drop blueprint topics into the grid in bulk. Auto-populate places lectures, labs, tests, and homework in the correct columns based on your blueprint order. Fill Problem Sessions labels empty Lab-mode cells.

The red buttons wipe content so you can start over - they only affect this one calendar.

steps.title: Save / Undo / Redo
steps.content: Edits you make to cells are held in your browser until you click Save All (or press Ctrl+S). Undo/Redo step through this session's changes. If you navigate away with unsaved changes, your browser will warn you.

steps.title: Intro texts
steps.content: Use these optional Moodle editors for student-facing text shown above the calendar. The left and right areas are useful for reminders, overview text, links, office hours, or other context students should see before the grid.

steps.title: The semester grid
steps.content:
The top row is the header: columns 1-3 are class days, and column 4 is homework. Each row below is one week.

Drag any content cell onto another cell to swap them. Click Edit cell to change text content, choose a topic block, set a cell heading, or toggle highlighting and vertical centering.

steps.title: Editing topic blocks
steps.content:
When a cell shows a Topic block, the cell content field is hidden because the displayed content comes from the shared blueprint topic.

The editor now shows a separate Shared blueprint topic area with a warning. Saving there updates the original topic and affects every place that topic is used. Cell heading, highlighting, and vertical centering still apply only to this one cell.

steps.title: You're ready to build
steps.content: Start by adding semester dates from Manage Rules, or use the auto-fill helpers once your blueprint topics are ready. Any time you want a refresher, click this Show walkthrough button to run the tour again.
